## Concrete production slice: living-source renewal

Implement bounded persistent renewal at the two reef ribbon catches and the two Canopy cured-resin pockets. Island drift resin remains its current finite first-access supply in this slice. Ordinary alloy/glass/crust stock, special caches, finite sorting reserves, food tending and protected recovery allocations retain their rules. Never infer renewal merely from region entry, rendering, save/load or wall-clock absence.

Root's initial tuning: each reef catch generates **2 membrane per6 active simulation minutes**; each Canopy pocket generates **2 resin per10 active simulation minutes**. Renewable exposed stock caps at that source's original exposed stock; never shrink pre-existing stock above that cap after sorting. Original finite reserves remain separate and are never replenished. Generation clips to remaining capacity; at/above the cap, discard progress rather than banking an instant refill. If ordinary sorting fills the cap, clear accumulated renewal progress in that same command/action transaction. Initial stock/reserve quantities are unchanged.

Use integer active-step progress, not Date.now, frame count, renderer residency or per-session timestamps. Initialize progress to zero. Advance only through normal active post-opening simulation; pause/menu transactions/export/import/Continue/offline time generate nothing. Regrowth continues when the source is outside active render regions. Keep cost bounded per tick and independent of elapsed offline time. Normal depletion/renewal must already drive existing visible stock meshes through the same authoritative state; no separate visual supply counter. Source status should briefly distinguish replenishing sheds from finite stock, without countdown clutter or generic notices every tick.

These are tuning hypotheses, not verified satisfaction. You may recommend different rates with finite-economy and expedition-cycle reasoning; implement the specified baseline unless concrete evidence requires a bounded change, then document the exact reason and resulting loop. Progression and recovery must remain possible with **zero renewal credited**. No quest ever requires waiting for it. It rewards later revisits rather than replacing exploration.

## Progression audit and bounded fixes

Produce a full acquisition matrix covering all six hull roles, mobile-home options/service stops, personal pressure tiers and meaningful survival conveniences. For each: discovery/blueprint, preceding capability, accessible material tier, required bench/service, actual new capability, useful mission before the next improvement, and continuing value of earlier equipment. Use existing canon/specification IDs; do not invent a competing recipe registry. Clearly label implemented versus planned. Keep reveal details outside the ordinary report.

Audit current command enforcement and fabricator visibility with fresh starts, reversed clue order and direct attempts lacking prerequisite knowledge. If there is a genuine current bypass, premature unlock or misleading buildable-plan presentation, fix it in owned paths with a meaningful regression. Do not introduce arbitrary flags to make the tree appear longer. New-game craftability proof and a current earned progression sequence are required even if no gate defect exists.

Identify circular prerequisites, unlock piles, reward droughts, obligatory optional purchases and invalid early-material shortcuts. Preserve both upgraded-Creel and Hearthline/Mantle ending strategies, optional Hush/Spindle, and the carrier's midcampaign attainment. Separate personal/hull depth. Record specific M2-B/C implementation order and route/payload/service requirements for unbuilt systems. Measured minimum travel is not human pacing; do not label the full curve implemented from a document/checker.
